EmbeddingGemma 2 (text and vision encoders)
-------------------------------------------

This product includes Google's EmbeddingGemma 2 embedding model, used on
device to place transcript text, on-screen text, and video frames in one
768-dimensional search space:

    https://huggingface.co/google/embeddinggemma-2
    (revision 914f7f89142e33e77833254d9c9b90c3cef7303b)

Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. The full license text is
included alongside this NOTICE at `EmbeddingGemma2-LICENSE.txt`.

The Core ML packages, token table, and vision position table are the
Apache-2.0 conversion published by FluidInference:

    https://huggingface.co/FluidInference/embeddinggemma-2-coreml
    (revision 3f978ddf92cac9aa07eb2dcf6eb36cf450f3dba4)

Youty ships the text and vision encoders unmodified (the audio encoder is
not included) and renames `embeddings.bf16` to `EmbeddingGemma2Tokens.bf16`
and `position_embeddings.f16` to `EmbeddingGemma2Positions.f16`. The
tokenizer is Google's original `tokenizer.json`; the compact `vocab.bin`,
`merges.bin`, and `added_tokens.bin` files are derived from it by
`Scripts/build-gemma-tokenizer-artifact.py`. Before adoption the converted
models were checked against Google's sentence-transformers reference on
saved-vault text and frames (`Scripts/verify-embeddinggemma2.py`).

SHA-256 of the shipped weights:

    EmbeddingGemma2Text.mlpackage   weight.bin  75b97ab036ca87ea…
    EmbeddingGemma2Vision.mlpackage weight.bin  5b5b6dd8d80aa438…
    EmbeddingGemma2Tokens.bf16                  56ebbdbfd706c827…
    EmbeddingGemma2Positions.f16                17de9480acc23638…
    tokenizer.json                              4d777ef5bdc1aa36…
